resources.string: You can customize the interface for your own fun or jokes! However, profanity and inappropriate language are blocked. Your joy is our app\'s success!
Sorry, you violated the app's rules with those words. If this happens again, your access will be partially restricted for one day.
You violated the rules 3 times. Prank Mode is blocked for you for 24 hours. Come back tomorrow with better words!
Sorry, couldn't find anything that fits your taste. You can change the settings as you like! 😊
Have some fear of God! Replace the text, or I'm calling in the squad! 😡
Couldn't find any other words? 🤣🤣 That doesn't make any sense! Replace it!
We're just friends! 😂 Let's get to the point, write your settings!
Writing a novel? 📝 These are menu settings, not War and Peace! Shorten the text!
Spamming your ads in my app's settings? 🤑 This isn't eBay! Remove the link!
Have you even written a line of code yourself to complain? 😉 The developer didn't sleep for this!
So, did you hack it? 💻 We aren't in Silicon Valley, this is Tajgram! Save the code for the Terminal!
Are you holding an official meeting in my menu? 🏛️ The app code won't handle that!
The smell of your virtual dollars is making me dizzy! 💰 Buy a Premium key first! 🤣
What are you hiding there? 👻 Don't leave the line empty, add at least a smiley face!
My ears are ringing! 📢 Write in lowercase, caps aren't in style here! 😂
Starting to speak in poetry? 📜 This is an app menu, not a poetry evening! Write it simply! 😉
Write at least one whole word! 🐌 Running out of letters? Think properly! 😂
Think you're Agent 007? 🕵️‍♂️ We've already tracked your coordinates! Take off the mask! 🤣
My mouth is watering! 🍔 Your kebabs made the server hungry! Settings first, eat later!
We're in the 21st century, you know! 🧙‍♂️ This is a smartphone, not a horse and carriage!
Careful, your crown might fall off! 👑 Rule your own kingdom; in Tajgram, all users are equal!
No drama, please, everything will be fine! 😭 If you flood the server with tears, it'll short-circuit! ✨
What Martian language are you writing in? 🤪 Have mercy on the keyboard, it's not to blame!
There's only one creator of Tajgram, and he's looking at your screen right now! 🕶️ Don't pretend to be the admin! 🤣
